title: Sample: Publish your first changelog page
body: Your merged pull requests now turn into a public **What's new** page that anyone can read without signing in.

title: Sample: Dates no longer shift by a day
body: Release dates were shown one day early for readers west of UTC. They now always match the date the release went out.

title: Sample: Update build dependencies
body: Routine dependency updates. Nothing changes for readers.

title: Sample: Group entries by type
body: Each release now lists breaking changes first, then new features, then fixes, so the important parts are at the top.

title: Sample: Long titles wrap on small screens
body: Entry titles no longer run off the edge of the page on phones.

title: Sample: Fix typo in internal error message
body: Corrects a typo that only showed up in server logs.

title: Sample: Entries file moves to data/entries.json
body:
The entries file has a new home. To upgrade:

- Move `changelog.json` to `data/entries.json`.
- Rename each entry's `type` field to `tag`.
- Read the [migration guide](https://example.com/docs/migrate-2-0) for the full list.

title: Sample: Hide entries from the public page
body: Mark an entry as hidden to keep it out of the public page while still keeping it in your history.

title: Sample: Subscribe with RSS
body: Follow new releases in your feed reader.

title: Sample: Keyboard focus is visible on links
body: Links now show a clear outline when you move to them with the keyboard.
